status: Qualified component; whole inference and vLLM parity objective remains active

implementation.owner: BnModelRuntime owns every immutable expert projection source; bn_model_free releases it after backend resources.
implementation.binding: bn_model_bind_trellis_experts uses architecture-owned component naming and registered trellis quant validation; validates all requested sources before publication. Failure preserves model, including existing runtime.
implementation.reader: Model exposes one immutable BnMoEExpertReader, usable by the existing bounded RAM cache; reads allocate no memory. Caller-owned caches and leases must expire before model free.
implementation.limits: Counts/dimensions come from validated caller config. This API does not parse config, bind full topology, register an executor, or enable ordinary generation.
implementation.storage: Index/files are borrowed and must remain immutable and alive. Only projection marker bodies are read during binding; compressed expert bodies remain on disk.

validation.cleanup: Actual FFN probe now frees GPU resources and catalog through bn_model_free; synthetic callback asserts catalog remains accessible during backend release.
validation.rollback: Synthetic late bad marker and missing component repeated 20 times each; wrong dimensions, counts and architecture, duplicate bind, pinned host cache and prefill staging also tested under Clang ASAN/UBSAN.

limitations: Full native config/anatomy, routing scheduler and generation remain unimplemented.
Actual FFN inputs are deterministic fixtures, not full-model hidden states.
Bound is requested compressed-weight GPU payload only; request buffers, context/library allocations, host metadata/cache/staging and OS page cache are separate.
Catalog max RSS includes linked runtime and index metadata; it is not total system footprint. OS storage coldness was not controlled.
No new prefill/decode throughput or vLLM parity claim.
